articles.title: Why banks and offshore hubs like Dubai are winners of the Senate killing the Clarity Act
articles.snippet: One expert believes that the failure to pass the bill is a win for the banks that staunchly oppose stablecoin yields, while a global crypto lawyer believes overseas jurisdictions benefit.

articles.title: Clarity Act, we hardly knew ye: We look at what was in the bill and what's replacing it
articles.snippet: U.S. agencies are racing to substitute their regulations for the law that was meant to set crypto markets in governmental bedrock, but will the stand-ins last?

articles.title: Europe’s Central Bank Prepares to Invest Own Funds in Tokenized Securities
articles.snippet: The central bank plans to buy euro-denominated public-sector debt and settle the transactions through its new Pontes service.

articles.title: CFTC Kicks Off Crypto Rulemaking, Bypassing a Stalled Congress
articles.snippet: The agency submitted a prerule on crypto asset transactions and markets to the White House for review, signaling it will build a derivatives framework on its own authority after the Clarity Act's collapse.

articles.title: OpenAI Models Are Writing Their Own Jailbreak Instructions—And Sometimes Obeying Them
articles.snippet: OpenAI's new transparency framework reveals AI models that invented fake "breach alerts," coached themselves to hide mistakes, and smuggled a file onto the public internet to talk to each other.
